teaser.en: Burn this shrub as firewood, it is said, and the family will quarrel until the homestead breaks apart.
teaser.sw: Inasemekana ukikichoma kichaka hiki kama kuni, familia itagombana hadi boma lisambaratike.
teaser.dg: Nkugombwa kukala uchiocha chitsaka chihi dza kuni, mbari indaheha hadi mudzi uvundzike.

summary.en: *Mfumula ndolwa* is a rare shrub of dry lowland forest, including the Shimba Hills. Its name means 'disperser of the homestead', and people avoid using it for firewood or building.
summary.sw: *Mfumula ndolwa* ni kichaka adimu cha misitu mikavu ya nyanda za chini, ikiwemo Shimba Hills. Jina lake lina maana ya 'mtawanyaji wa boma', na watu huepuka kukitumia kwa kuni au ujenzi.
summary.dg: *Mfumula ndolwa* ni chitsaka adimu cha matsaka makavu ga herera, phamwenga na Shimba Hills. Dzinare maanaye ni 'unaotawanya mudzi', na atu nkuuhepa kuuhumira kpwa kuni au kudzengera.

about.en: *Mfumula ndolwa* is a shrub of the coffee family, with leaves in opposite pairs and small fruits that grow in pairs. It is an unassuming plant to look at, and much easier to recognise by reputation than by sight.
about.sw: *Mfumula ndolwa* ni kichaka cha familia ya mibuni, chenye majani yanayokabiliana kwa jozi na matunda madogo yanayoota kwa jozi. Si mmea wa kuvutia macho, na ni rahisi zaidi kukitambua kwa sifa yake kuliko kwa kukiona.
about.dg: *Mfumula ndolwa* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa, chenye makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganayololana, na matunda madide ganayomera mairi-mairi. Kpwa kuulola tauna chitu cha ajabu, na ni rahisi zaidi kuumanya kpwa dzinare kuriko kpwa kuuona.

where.en: It grows in dry lowland forest and Brachystegia woodland, at around 30 to 130 m above sea level. It is one of four threatened plants of the Shimba Hills.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu ya nyanda za chini na mapori ya miombo (*Brachystegia*), kwenye mwinuko wa takriban m 30 hadi 130 juu ya usawa wa bahari. Ni mojawapo ya mimea minne iliyo hatarini ya Shimba Hills.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu ga herera na matsaka ga *Brachystegia*, phephi mita 30 hadi 130 dzulu ya bahari. Ni mwenga wa mimea mine iriyo hatarini ya Shimba Hills.

uses.en: It is deliberately avoided. People do not cut it for firewood or building poles.
uses.sw: Huepukwa kwa makusudi. Watu hawakikati kwa kuni wala kwa nguzo za ujenzi.
uses.dg: Nkuhepwa kpwa makusudi. Atu taaukata kpwa kuni wala kpwa mihi ya kudzengera.

culture.en: The name means 'disperser of the homestead'. It is believed that using the wood for firewood or house poles causes quarrels in the family, until the family splits and the homestead scatters. The belief has a protective effect: a plant no one will burn is a plant left standing.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mtawanyaji wa boma'. Inaaminika kwamba kutumia mbao zake kwa kuni au nguzo za nyumba husababisha ugomvi katika familia, hadi familia igawanyike na boma litawanyike. Imani hii ina athari ya kukilinda: mmea ambao hakuna atakayeuchoma ni mmea unaoachwa umesimama.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri maanaye ni 'unaotawanya mudzi'. Atu anaamini kukala uchihumira nyama za muhi uhu dza kuni au mihi ya nyumba, kunareha kondo mbarini, hadi mbari ivundzike na mudzi utawanyike. Imani ihi inauhifadhi muhi: muhi ambao takuna anayeuocha ni muhi unaobaki uchiima.

names.en: The Digo name is *mfumula ndolwa*, which Giriama shares. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded. Older sources list it as *Canthium kilifiense*; today it is *Afrocanthium kilifiense*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mfumula ndolwa*, ambalo linatumika pia katika Kigiriama. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Vyanzo vya zamani vinakiorodhesha kama *Canthium kilifiense*; leo ni *Afrocanthium kilifiense*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mfumula ndolwa*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chigiriama. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Vitabu vya kare vinauandika dza *Canthium kilifiense*; rero ni *Afrocanthium kilifiense*.

conservation.en: *Mfumula ndolwa* is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List and is counted among four threatened plants of the Shimba Hills. Its survival depends on the remaining dry lowland forest.
conservation.sw: *Mfumula ndolwa* kimeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN na kinahesabiwa miongoni mwa mimea minne iliyo hatarini ya Shimba Hills. Kuendelea kuwepo kwake kunategemea misitu mikavu ya nyanda za chini iliyobaki.
conservation.dg: *Mfumula ndolwa* ukaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List, na ni mwenga wa mimea mine iriyo hatarini ya Shimba Hills. Ili ubaki, unaluphira matsaka makavu ga herera garigobaki.
